initiative.title: Realtime note updates
initiative.summary: Push a signal-only notes:changed event over an authenticated WebSocket from one Prisma write hook so open tabs revalidate lists and safely refresh open notes when notes are written elsewhere (MCP, other tabs, CLI, extension).
initiative.next_action: Start M1: note event bus + Prisma hook + /ws/notes + NoteLiveSync list revalidation; run the vinxi ws auth spike first.

claims.statement: Notes written outside the open tab must appear in it without a manual refresh.
WebSocket is a suggested mechanism, not a requirement; appetite is small.
Open note auto-refreshes only when clean; dirty shows a changed-elsewhere notice; never overwrite unsaved edits.
Every note write source publishes updates, not only MCP.
Priority views: notes index/search, path/tree views, recently changed lists. Canvas/UMAP not selected.
Existing ws plumbing (jobs socket, BroadcastChannel bus, reconnecting client) exists but has no browser consumer and no auth.
List views use createAsync + query keys (revalidate works); note page/editor/side panel use createResource and need explicit refetch.

questions: Open note behavior on external change
answers: Auto-refresh if clean, notice if dirty

shape.appetite: Small: a few focused PRs reusing existing ws plumbing; no new dependency or migration.
shape.problem: Open tabs never learn about writes from other places, so MCP-created notes are invisible until refresh.
shape.recommended_shape: Prisma $extends query hook on Doc writes publishes {id, updatedAt}[] | null to an in-process BroadcastChannel; authenticated /ws/notes fans out notes:changed; client NoteLiveSync debounces and revalidates note list query keys, refetches registered open-note resources when clean, shows a notice when dirty, ignores its own saves by updatedAt; reconnect/focus catch-up; VITE_NOTE_LIVE_SYNC flag.

success_moves.move: Events are invalidation signals, not data; clients re-run existing queries.
success_moves.risk: client-side content merge cache and divergence

success_moves.move: Single publish point in a Prisma query hook rather than ten write sites.
success_moves.risk: a write path forgets to publish

success_moves.move: Copy the proven jobs socket pattern but add cookie auth on open.
Pure decision function for open-note refresh (ignore own save, queue during save, clean refetch, dirty notice) with unit tests.
Client-side flag and reconnect/focus revalidate floor; SSE fallback behind same provider.

first_proof.question: Does a write from another source (MCP) reach an open tab's list views live, without disturbing the writing tab?
first_proof.artifact: Local dev: notes index open in browser, MCP Inspector create_note; second tab save does not jump cursor
first_proof.decision_rule: Both hold: proceed to open-note handling and deployed check. ws router cannot upgrade or authenticate under vinxi: switch transport to SSE behind the same client provider.

rabbit_holes: Self-echo refetch during save resetting editor content
Publishing from inside interactive $transaction before commit
createResource views not responding to revalidate
Production proxy idle timeout and Upgrade forwarding
